verdict: CHANNEL SCOPED: the non-cancelling one-way transport requirement is already realized in the corpus through the GNSS downlink clock channel (step 135/b99 axis hit); deep-space public one-way archives (Voyager delta-VLBI 1979-81, Cassini VLBA, PRIDE VEX/MEX) are inner-system or not publicly reduced at observable level; no public one-way dataset covers the boundary-distance regime -- registered as an identified, open channel with named holdings, not a tested one

T1_transport_class.requirement: onboard-oscillator-referenced one-way carrier transport across the lapse gradient; the lapse term cannot cancel as in two-way links

realized_in_corpus.result: step 135 / b99: free 2701-direction clock axis 0.6 deg from the comet meridian plane, 22.0 deg from the CMB apex (out-of-sample p=0.010)

T1_transport_class.note: GNSS downlink is the same photon-transport class as VLBI spacecraft downlink: one-way, uplink-free, onboard-oscillator referenced.  The non-cancelling channel the cancellation theorem demands is therefore already realized in the corpus and returns the programme's strongest cross-channel directional hit.

voyager_delta_vlbi.mode: downlink-only delta-VLBI / delta-DOR (360 kHz telemetry subcarrier harmonics)
voyager_delta_vlbi.note: observables not in a public machine-readable archive; pre-interstellar distances only

cassini_vlba.mode: one-way downlink, phase-referenced to ICRF quasars
cassini_vlba.note: position solutions published; raw delay observables not publicly archived

pride_vex_mex.sensitivity: mHz-level open-loop Doppler (Bocanegra Bahamon et al. 2019; Duev et al. 2012)
pride_vex_mex.public_observables: raw correlator-level data at the EVN archive; processed Doppler products in the published record

T3_boundary_coverage.voyager_at_150au: carrier receivable only by 70-m-class apertures; no public VLBI record exists at boundary distances
T3_boundary_coverage.conclusion: no public one-way dataset covers the boundary-distance regime; the deep-space one-way channel is identified and scoped but not populated at the relevant distance

gnss_clock_channel.note: sub-ns carrier-phase clock comparisons over a global network, 25 yr baseline -- the realized highest-sensitivity one-way channel in the corpus

T4_sensitivity.ordering: GNSS clock network >> PRIDE open-loop Doppler > 1979 delta-VLBI demonstration, in realized one-way sensitivity
